title: Mé féin agus mo theaghlach

patterns.title: Mo agus séimhiú
patterns.question: Cad é a tharlaíonn don fhocal i ndiaidh mo? Cad chuige nach n-athraíonn leabhar ná athair ar an dóigh chéanna?
patterns.questionEn: What happens to the word after mo? Why do leabhar and athair not change in the same way?
patterns.rule: Mo puts a h after the first letter (séimhiú): mo dheartháir. L, n and r never take h: mo leabhar. Before a vowel, mo becomes m': m'athair.

ladder.en: There are five people in my family. I get on very well with my youngest brother because we like the same things, but I have to say that we argue about the television from time to time.

title: Laethanta saoire
teaches: Talking about last summer's holiday in the past tense, with muid for we (chuaigh muid, chaith muid); go dtí + the article, go + a place name; ar an + séimhiú (ar an bhád) and i + urú (i bpuball); weather graded from go hálainn to go holc; a reason with mar; the future for next summer (rachaidh muid).

patterns.title: I agus urú
patterns.question: Cad chuige a n-athraíonn an litriú i gcuid acu ach nach n-athraíonn sé i gcuid eile?
patterns.questionEn: Why does the spelling change in some of them but not in others?
patterns.rule: I eclipses the next word: i bpuball, i gcarbhán. Before a vowel, i becomes in: in óstán. L, m, n, r and s do not change.

patterns.title: Ar an agus séimhiú
patterns.question: Cad é a tharlaíonn i ndiaidh ar an i gcanúint Uladh?
patterns.questionEn: What happens after ar an in Ulster Irish?
patterns.rule: In Ulster, ar an puts a h on the next word: ar an bhád, ar an bhus. T, d and vowels do not change: ar an traein, ar an eitleán.

ladder.ga: Chuaigh mé go dtí an Spáinn ar mo laethanta saoire. Chuaigh mé ann ar an eitleán. D'fhan mé cúig lá.
ladder.en: I went to Spain on my holidays. I went there on the plane. I stayed five days.
ladder.label: Bunúsach

ladder.ga: [Thaistil] mé go dtí an Spáinn [le mo theaghlach i mí Iúil. D'eitil muid ó Bhéal Feirste go Málaga agus chaith muid] cúig lá ann. [Bhí muid ag stopadh in óstán mór in aice leis an trá.]
ladder.en: I travelled to Spain with my family in July. We flew from Belfast to Málaga and we spent five days there. We were staying in a big hotel beside the beach.
ladder.label: Níos fearr

ladder.ga: Thaistil mé go dtí an Spáinn le mo theaghlach i mí Iúil. D'eitil muid ó Bhéal Feirste go Málaga agus chaith muid cúig lá ann. Bhí muid ag stopadh in óstán mór in aice leis an trá. [Thaitin an tsaoire go mór liom mar bhí an aimsir go hálainn, ach caithfidh mé a rá go raibh sé róthe ag am lóin. An bhliain seo chugainn, ba mhaith liom dul go dtí an Iodáil.]
ladder.en: … I really enjoyed the holiday because the weather was lovely, but I have to say it was too hot at lunchtime. Next year I would like to go to Italy.
ladder.label: Is fearr
